rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for things that are neat and tidy.

example.english: You keep your room very orderly.
example.jyutping: nei5 gaan1 fong2 zap1 dak1 hou2 kei5 lei5

rows.note: Use this for a person, plan, or process that is methodical and well organized.

example.english: They explain things in a very orderly way.
example.jyutping: keoi5 gong2 je5 hou2 jau5 tiu4 lei5

rows.note: Use this when “orderly” means following a regular pattern or governing rule, as in an orderly universe.

example.english: The universe runs in an orderly pattern.
example.traditional: 呢個宇宙運行得好有規律。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 jyu5 zau6 wan6 hang4 dak1 hou2 jau5 kwai1 leot6

rows.note: Use this for a crowd, place, or situation that is orderly and under control.

example.english: The people in the queue are very orderly.
example.jyutping: paai4 deoi6 ge3 jan4 hou2 jau5 dit6 zeoi6
